segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report it helps with excess oil and doesn't feel greasy, including one who says active breakouts improved without irritation; one reviewer with oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin, however, noticed no visible benefit after a while.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it relieves flakiness and peeling and leaves skin more hydrated and soft, including one whose skin was drier than usual due to a topical treatment.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who specifically identifies as having combination skin reports fast absorption, a glow, and no irritation.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are mostly positive, reporting no breakouts, less redness, and improved comfort, including one with rosacea who had only slight, temporary irritation at first; one reviewer, however, says the product was not suitable for her sensitive skin at all.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report firmer, tighter, less crepey skin and diminished fine lines with continued use; dissent includes two reviewers who, after about a month, say they see no clear firming or fine-line effect yet, and one who found it slower to reduce fine lines than a comparable product.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the serum as strongly hydrating and plumping, often noticeable within days; a couple of dissenting reviewers, however, say it feels too thin and doesn't leave their skin feeling hydrated.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report a visible reduction, including one who calls it the only product that has ever helped her chronic flushing; one reviewer, however, says she saw little difference after several weeks, and a reviewer with rosacea cautions that the niacinamide and ferments can trigger mild flushing in some rosacea-prone skin.
concerns.barrier: The large majority of reviewers report a visibly stronger, calmer, more resilient skin barrier, often citing better tolerance of exfoliation or other actives; two reviewers, however, say they saw no barrier improvement, with one suggesting a faster-acting product for an already irritated barrier.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who specifically looked for fading of spots says she hasn't seen that effect after a month of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who describe themselves as acne-prone, report no new breakouts and some say existing acne cleared up; dissent includes two reviewers who developed small bumps or textured skin around the eyes and mouth after a few months, and one who noticed clogged pores after about two weeks.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin or oily zones report it helps reduce excess sebum and shine without adding greasiness, with no reviewer reporting increased oiliness.

extraits.texte: Product has really good ingredients but unfortunately it's not suitable for my sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: It's a good and well-rounded hydrating and soothing serum
extraits.texte: It's a good product especially for the price point and ingredients. I was looking for something soothing and hydrating because I was going to start using more aggressive actives so I wanted to see how this would work on my skin before I used such ingredients, but I noticed that while it did work I was developing little bumps around my eyes and I got more texture around my mouth/chin area. I was using this for a little over 3 months, and the bottle lasted me a while, but I don't think I will be purchasing again and I also will not recommend this if you want a minimal routine. not because its bad but because it just doesn't do enough for me. I'm still in the search for a holy grail item that targets soothing irritated and hydrates as well while still being a minimal skin care routine, unfortunately this didn't make the cut but it's not bad. I'd say this is more suited for dry or dehydrated skin, Tho if you have an irritated barrier I'd probably use something else that works quicker and more effectively as this took a while for me to see results and even then, these aren't the results I'd like to see in that time frame. I think it's a great hyaluronic acid serum but I'm now moving towards products that do multiple things in one for a simpler routine and this is not that.

I didn't see results right away. I think I would needed 2 months to really tell. I'm naturally oily and I felt it did help with the oiliness. I did have to stop using it because I was using it with these skin peeling pads and the ingredients didn't like each other and I broke out. But once I stopped using both of them and then started back with the oil by itself, it was fine.

extraits.titre: Definitely make it a part of my routine
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After trying the Manyo Bifida Biome Complex Ampoule, this is my experience: My skin feels silky-smooth and well-hydrated, never sticky. I especially love the natural glow it leaves, which looks beautiful when worn with just sunscreen. The consistency is perfect—not too thick or runny—and it absorbs easily without piling. The packaging (both bottle and external box) is elegant and practical, making application enjoyable. This serum contains a high percentage of Bifida ferment lysate (72%), multiple types of hyaluronic acid, peptides, and soothing extracts like Centella (asiaticoside, asiatic acid, madecassic acid). It's fragrance-free and paraben-free, which is ideal for sensitive skin. I have rosacea, and while I experienced very slight irritation at first, it did not cause breakouts, redness, or flare-ups. Despite my sensitive skin, I was able to use this ampoule without major issues. It leaves a radiant, hydrated finish that feels light and comfortable, like a protective layer without heaviness. ⚠️ Note for sensitive/rosacea-prone skin: Most ingredients here are soothing, but niacinamide and some ferments can sometimes trigger mild flushing. In my case, irritation was minimal and temporary. If your skin reacts strongly to ferments or niacinamide, patch testing is essential. Overall, I love this product, of no further irritation, I will definitely make it a part of my routine.

I didn't notice a difference in my skin at first because it was so gradual, but MAN did I notice one when I stopped using it! I was using so many products I couldn't tell what was doing what to my skin. This one I can say SINGLE HANDEDLY cured my redness! I don't have rosacea or anything extreme like that but my face is naturally more flushed, which doesn't show up very well in pictures. I noticed when I was using this my face looked SO good in pictures, and when I stopped... well... not as great. I also was breaking out a bunch more when I wasn't using it, I thought it was my birth control that was clearing my skin, and a change in ingredients or something when I started breaking out more, turns out it was this! The second I bought another one and started using it again my skin instantly looked healthy again the next day; glowy, even, bright, clear... just healthy all around! I will never make the mistake of not repurchasing again. I am locked in with this one for life now. It's the ONLY thing that has ever helped my redness, and just my skin all around, especially this drastically. This is now one of my holy grails.

extraits.titre: A Great Introduction to this Brand!
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Having never heard of this brand, I was super excited to test this serum out. For reference, my skin is dry, sensitive, and textured. This formula did not cause any irritation on my skin. As of the writing of this review, I've been using this in the morning daily, to the point to where I'm a little below half of the bottle. I have to say….wow. This serum provides instant life and hydration into my skin in the morning. My skin has been even more dry than usual due to a topical treatment I've been using nightly. We are talking about lots of peeling, so my skin needs extra nourishment. This has made the peeling process of my treatment much more tolerable. My skin's barrier has greatly benefited from this product. My experience has been so good that I'm looking into trying their other products. I highly recommend this product if you're looking to strengthen and maintain your skin barrier/prone to breakouts!

The ampoule absorbs fast without leaving any residue or stickiness, and there's no noticeable scent, which makes it ideal for sensitive skin. The product has a watery texture that's easy to apply and a little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts quite a while. I have oily, acne prone, sensitive skin and since I started using it, I haven't experienced any new breakouts, which is rare for me, and I've noticed a visible reduction in redness on active pimples and post acne marks. My pimples seem to heal faster and with less irritation. I use it at night and by morning, my skin looks smoother, plumper and more even toned without feeling oily or greasy. I found this ampoule to be very gentle, effective, calming and hydrating. It has helped to strengthen my skin barrier without clogging my pores or causing breakouts. I received this product complimentary for testing, but all opinions are my own.
